production_policy: Unchanged; all candidates and native injection isolated in new scripts.
history: V2b completion is rejected and will not be reimplemented or threshold-tuned. Existing Z/Y/X exact merge is the baseline, not a straw-man singleton extractor.

offline.inputs: Actual immutable canonical snapshots or explicit canonical replay of recorded RGB-D; cumulative hit masks are not canonical occupancy.
offline.camera_scope: Historical V2b EYES reference distinguished from authored A_current. Fresh authored-A captures qualify primary conclusions; C uses identical fixed rays for within-layout comparisons.
selection: optional immutable motion context with explicit outside-corridor reserve
offline.adjacency: Face6 exact compression graph; Chebyshev radius2 is separately reported support and never permits filling cells.
offline.correctness: All candidate and selected box cell unions must be subsets of original unexpired eligible OCCUPIED evidence; no FREE/UNKNOWN/out-of-grid cells, overlap duplication, padding or TTL extension. Explicit omitted-cell and FREE-gap audits.
offline.shortlist: At most two candidates; choose using exactness, observed physical endpoint coverage, omissions, gap preservation, churn and measured worker cost before evaluating native outcomes.
offline.reject: Any invented/expired geometry or gap bridge; unbounded CPU cost; meaningful hazard-coverage loss without explicit tradeoff. Negligible packing gains are retained as negative findings.
offline.worker_cost_target: Extraction should be a small fraction of500ms; report p50/p95/worst. Over100ms p95 requires explicit rejection or measured capacity justification; no freshness relaxation.

native.fixture_policy: Existing exact START/GOAL, physical scenes and limits; distinguish historical sparse rectangular box from new true-cylinder/prism fixture. No production scene edits.
native.setup: Production extractor during unmeasured approach; all baseline/candidates start from matched actual joints and fixtures, then candidate worker packet must be fresh before command.
native.outcomes: Keep measurement validity, reached goal, zero-contact success, reference clearance and ungraded contact severity separate. No safe-contact threshold.
native.repeats: Repeat the most meaningful baseline/candidate improvements and regressions at least once; no large native search.
native.controls: Reuse prior direct controls only with explicit identical scene/initial-state/target/gain/source proof; new empty/cylinder controls where no matched prior run exists.
native.timing: Dense processing and I/O off Kit; no concurrent CPU-heavy analysis during measured native runs; registry SDK calls remain owner-thread-only. Full forensic captures cannot establish live timing.
native.stop: Stop escalation for GPU/resource failures, repeat source failures or severe control stalls; retain unmeasured/failed records.
native.actual_setup_match_scope: Same ordinary production-extractor setup; compare actual joint vectors and fixture/calibration/configuration; within0.01rad predeclared limit, not bitwise-identical native state. Static Lula comparisons use exactly identical q/qd.
native.finite_primary_matrix: A/C×empty/static/sparse rectangularpost/cylinder/partial/narrow/moving×baseline/diversity/motion=42 reactive cases, interleaved baseline and candidates by scenario/layout.
native.predeclared_repeats: Astatic andCnarrow known failure modes: repeat all3 representations twice more (12 additional reactive cases), retain all outcomes.
native.new_direct_controls: A/C empty and actualcylinder, four freshcontrols; otherhistoricaldirectcontrols remainseparateunless criticalsource/config/calibration/initialq/actorpose equivalence isproved.

static_lula.inputs: Actual observed selected packets from offline snapshots
static_lula.matches: q,qd,target,installed policy configuration and physical scene fixed within representation comparison
static_lula.sensitivity: Multiple recorded arm configurations plus small metric translations; same union comparison separated from changed budget-selected unions
static_lula.units: Natural RMP force/metric are not Newtons or torques; keep static responses separate from physical outcomes.

completion: Targeted algorithm units; existing unit/architecture suite; matched physical motion; source preservation; reusable scripts/report/compact evidence committed and branch pushed only.

offline_completed_before_native_shortlis.rejected_native_packings: All6axisorders/greedy/component equal baseline geometry/count on all66 actual snapshots; no compression benefit.
offline_completed_before_native_shortlis.rejected_selection: Global coverage loses known observed physical hazards to floor geometry.
